objective: Replicate local output-cost prediction and its transport through one actual attention+MLP block of unchanged Qwen3.5-0.8B.
scope: Adapt Theorem1 and AppendixB.1, not a complete reproduction of concept-steering benchmarks or a conservation/equilibrium theorem.

questions.text: Why does a metal spoon feel colder than a wooden spoon when both have been in the same room all day?
A gardener puts 6 seedlings into each of 3 trays, then plants 5 of those seedlings outside. How many seedlings remain in the trays?
Answer with is or are only: The basket of red apples ___ on the counter.
Every glimmer is a nork. No nork is a zelp. Can any glimmer be a zelp? Answer yes or no.

position: last prompt token only; actual full-prefix native computation; use_cache=False; no generated continuation

directions.kind: fresh Gaussian directions projected off study11 four-direction span and orthonormalized

precision.primary: actual FP32 full-model states and exact stored weights promoted to FP32
precision.control: native BF16 complete same-context intervention panel; record actual delivered input; no FP32 prediction-accuracy claim on its different baseline states

prediction: Actual automatic directional derivatives; no activation-function replacement, covariance fit, classifier, or model training. Three independently differentiated injection sites give cost transport. Full-vocabulary endpoint KL is the independent finite-response test.
intervention: Add alpha*v to last-token block input, before input RMSNorm and attention. For derivative transport only, middle seeding is delivered by adding to attention-branch output before the residual sum so that both MLP input and its identity path change. Output seeding occurs after the full block.
no_retuning: Freeze all inputs and sources before native calls. Freeze all FP32 predictions before any primary signed interventions. Calibration numerical gates precede held measurements. Retain challenge failures; do not redefine the primary band from held results.
limits: Four questions are two calibration plus two held-out questions, not hundreds of independent examples.
Four directions probe a four-dimensional subspace, not the full1024D Fisher spectrum.
Transport agreement is a chain-rule identity, not physical conservation or equilibrium.
Scalar output cost is not a semantic label or a steering detector.
BF16/FP32 full-model differences include changed baseline states; not a uniquely isolated rounding attribution.
